scope: Every actual E03 line mapped to a human-audited narrative beat. Distinct per-line source indices are complete, while deep commentary is organized at beat level. No claim of 69-episode completion.

beats.fact: E03 begins with source URL and section separator.
beats.mechanism: No scene event.

beats.fact: Dhika chooses skirt and sleeveless top while anticipating Chotu's opinion; she sees modest skin visibility and applies light makeup.
beats.mechanism: Unlike the accidental missing shawl in E01, her choice is now deliberate and self-observed.

beats.fact: Chotu arrives; Dhika greets him with playful face touch and asks about his sudden leave.
beats.mechanism: Touch is familiar greeting, not new sexual encounter.

beats.fact: Chotu notices her outfit. He states his grandmother died and he had to visit his village.
beats.mechanism: Prior speculation that leave was caused by Dhika is corrected by source.

beats.fact: Dhika reaches upward and sees Chotu notice her uncovered midriff; she teases him, and he awkwardly denies looking.
beats.mechanism: Actual visual observation, teasing and Dhika's private pleasure are distinct.

beats.fact: Chotu goes back for ice creams; his own thoughts combine attraction and concern about betraying Dhika's trust.
beats.mechanism: Chotu has separate viewpoint rather than simply mirroring Dhika.

beats.fact: He returns; they sit together eating ice cream, discuss his supposed girlfriends and joke.
beats.mechanism: Friendly banter and changed physical proximity create scene structure.

beats.fact: Each casually cleans a drip of ice cream; Dhika's knees make contact with Chotu's during laughter.
beats.mechanism: Small distinct touches; track agency separately.

beats.fact: Dhika's ice cream drops on her stomach. Chotu instinctively removes it with a finger, then apologizes; Dhika laughs and reassures him.
beats.mechanism: Actual brief contact is distinct from prior visual-only incidents.

beats.fact: Dhika asks about kissing; Chotu admits inexperience. They exchange a flying-kiss gesture and fall silent after noticing each other's lips.
beats.mechanism: Conversation and gesture increase anticipation; flying kiss is not actual lip contact.

beats.fact: Narrator alternates both characters' unspoken questions about whether a kiss would be welcomed.
beats.mechanism: Dual internal viewpoint; intentions not yet the action.

beats.fact: Chotu kisses Dhika on lips and she reciprocates; she rises abruptly, later says she liked it, and both separate.
beats.mechanism: First evidenced reciprocal nonmarital kiss; repeated L94/95 prose does not imply a second kiss.

beats.fact: Dhika reflects on liking the kiss, feels guilt and declines to tell John; narrator says she does not acknowledge her reciprocation to herself.
beats.mechanism: Internal denial versus reader-known action is essential.

beats.fact: Wednesday 3 PM tutoring begins. All behave as if prior accidental clothing incident had not happened.
beats.mechanism: Academic cover and restraint restore social routine.

beats.fact: Bantu compliments her homewear; Bobby is shy. Dhika removes dupatta and discusses feeling comfortable and being known to them.
beats.mechanism: Bantu notices and strategically exploits the trust argument.

beats.fact: Dhika challenges Bobby to compliment her; he delivers a confident compliment. She changes to casual homewear, Bantu adds flirtatious comments; tuition resumes.
beats.mechanism: Bobby's distinct assertiveness triggers Dhika's choice; not all action originates with Bantu.

beats.fact: Dhika notices Pappu's marked walls, suggests painting the room, and mentions Chotu as helper. John approves and notices her subtle blush.
beats.mechanism: Practical domestic project creates repeat Chotu access; John notices but does not know kiss.

beats.fact: Friday tutoring begins in a saree; leaning and fan cause pallu to fall. Both twins see; Dhika reacts with distress.
beats.mechanism: Accidental event repeated; no evidence this second slip was arranged.

beats.fact: Dhika cries. Bobby wipes a tear and gives extended reassurance about their discretion.
beats.mechanism: One of Bobby's strongest independent trust-building actions; cheek touch is comforting.

beats.fact: Bantu uses humor and compliments to help her regain composure; Dhika feels reassured but hides the incident from John.
beats.mechanism: Distinct emotional jobs: Bobby reassures, Bantu shifts mood. Unlike E02, John is not told.

beats.fact: Saturday family routine interrupts painting. On Sunday John takes Pappu while Dhika prepares to work.
beats.mechanism: Logistical absence, not automatic proof of intentional affair planning.

beats.fact: Dhika cleans walls and calls Maami for Chotu's help despite prior kiss-related awkwardness. Chotu is available and accepts.
beats.mechanism: An established practical plan motivates reunion.

beats.fact: Chotu arrives quieter than before, privately considers apologizing; Dhika avoids the kiss topic while privately remembering and feeling conflicted.
beats.mechanism: Shared memory but different strategies: apology withheld, topic avoided.

beats.fact: Dhika asks for flexible help; they scrape old wall paint together in separate parts of room.
beats.mechanism: Repeated joint work access established without needing implausible new setting.

beats.fact: Dhika sees her sweaty clothes and deliberately changes how she wears her T-shirt, partly to draw Chotu's gaze; he notices her appearance.
beats.mechanism: Prior ice-cream memory becomes a motif and influence on current action.

beats.fact: They plan lunch after work. Dhika reaches overhead for plates and is aware of Chotu's inspection and visible physical response.
beats.mechanism: Visual appreciation and witnessed response; no new intercourse or genital touching between participants evidenced here.

beats.fact: Closing blank lines and separator.
beats.mechanism: No additional plot event.

pair_milestones.chotu: First mutual lip kiss E03 L92-93, plus earlier accidental stomach contact L67-75, then repeated painting work; don't double-count repeated narrator sentence.
pair_milestones.bantu: Trust-framing and compliments E03 L108-136; reassures and mood-lifts after second accidental pallu slip L169-183.
pair_milestones.bobby: Independent compliment L121-125 and tears-wiping reassurance L163-168.
pair_milestones.john: Approves repainting, observes subtle blush; not told about Chotu kiss nor Friday clothing incident.

open_threads: John notices behavior but lacks knowledge.
Bantu's social initiative does not replace Bobby's independent advances.
Painter/tuition settings create different repeat-access contexts.
future_handling: E04 is already known, so forward threads are not independently blind predicted.
